From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 23 Aug 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MSA & Order Form — Finovate Systems (legal review)

Marissa / team — read Alex's redlines and did a first-pass. Summary of Redwood's position and asks for Finovate: 

1) Liability / Cap: Procurement's proposed uncapped liability for security incidents is not acceptable. We can offer an increased cap tied to fees (e.g., 2x the annual fees for the first year) but cannot accept unlimited liability.

2) Data retention / logs: Finovate's requested 90-day carveout for logs accessed by support needs clarification. We will accept a limited retention exception for diagnostic logs if: 
   - Access is audited and limited to named support engineers, and
   - Finovate signs a one-way NDA addendum for support access, and
   - They agree to a documented purge schedule for those logs.

3) Exhibit B (SLA): We can tighten response windows for P1/P2 incidents to match their expectation but will need to preserve our standard availability credits. Request specific wording examples from procurement on desired response times.

4) Security evidence: Please ask Finovate to provide their SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and any KMS/HSM architecture notes where they require customer-managed keys. If they plan to bring their own keys, we need exact integration/rotation requirements.

5) IP / Indemnity: Procurement language expands third-party indemnity too broadly. We'll propose a narrow indemnity for claims arising from customer data use and will strike broader product-level indemnities.

I've attached a short comment PDF with inline callouts (redline-comments.pdf). Suggested path: 1) intake call this week to walk commercial/legal items, 2) we send a counter-redline with callouts, 3) if material, escalate to execs for sign-off on credit/financial risk.

If Alex is available, propose Tue 26 Aug 09:00 PST or Tue 26 Aug 14:00 PST for the intake (30 min).

Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
